meta.name: google-cloud-waf-performance-optimization
meta.description: Generates performance-focused guidance for Google Cloud workloads based on the design principles and recommendations in the Performance Optimization pillar of the Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework (WAF). Use this skill to evaluate a workload, identify performance requirements, and provide actionable recommendations for resource allocation, modular design, and elasticity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估工作负载并给出性能优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在优化 Google Cloud 工作负载的性能
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate workloads and provide performance optimization recommendations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are optimizing performance of Google Cloud workloads

howto.what: Claude 会根据 Google Cloud Well-Architected Framework 的性能优化支柱，评估你的工作负载，并提供关于资源分配、模块化设计和弹性的可操作建议。
howto.when: 当你询问如何优化 Google Cloud 工作负载的性能，或要求评估架构时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估我的 GKE 集群性能，给出优化建议。
say.note: Claude 会询问性能需求并给出建议。

say.text: 如何为我的 Cloud Run 服务设置自动扩缩？
say.note: Claude 会提供弹性配置指导。

say.text: 我的数据库查询慢，怎么优化存储？
say.note: Claude 会建议缓存策略或存储类型调整。

howto.what_en: Claude evaluates your Google Cloud workload based on the Performance Optimization pillar of the Well-Architected Framework and provides actionable recommendations for resource allocation, modular design, and elasticity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about optimizing performance of Google Cloud workloads or request an architecture evaluation.

say_en.text: Evaluate my GKE cluster performance and give optimization tips.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about requirements and provide suggestions.

say_en.text: How do I set up autoscaling for my Cloud Run service?
say_en.note: Claude will guide on elasticity configuration.

say_en.text: My database queries are slow, how to optimize storage?
say_en.note: Claude may recommend caching or storage type changes.
